redflags.quote: On October 22, 2026, Nathen Fuentes resigned as Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective immediately. Fuentes stated that his decision was not the result of any disagreement regarding accounting principles or financial statement disclosures.
redflags.label: exchange listing notice

redflags.reason: Lunai Bioworks Inc. (the “Company”) is unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (the “Form 10-K”) within the prescribed time period. The Company anticipates that it will file the Form 10-K on or before the fifteenth calendar day following the prescribed due date, as permitted by Rule 12b-25(b
